Definations

  • Service refers to the website https://pixtar.ae operated by Pixtar Branding Services LLC.
  • Personal Data means any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
  • Usage Data refers to information collected automatically, either through Service use or Service infrastructure (e.g., page visit durations).
  • Cookies are small files stored on your device (computer or mobile device).
  • Data Controller means the natural or legal person responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing personal data. For this Privacy Policy, we are the Data Controller.
  • Data Processors (Or Service Providers)are third parties who process data on our behalf to make our Service more effective.
  • Data Subject refers to any living individual whose personal data is being processed.
  • User refers to the individual using our Service, who corresponds to the Data Subject.

Introduction Collection and Use

We collect different types of information for various purposes, to provide and enhance our Service.

Types of Data Collected:

Personal Data

While using our Service, we may request certain personally identifiable information to contact or identify you. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Email Address

  • Data Cookies

Usage Data

We may collect information that your browser sends during visits to our Service or when you access the Service via a mobile device. This may include:

Tracking Cookies Data

We use cookies to monitor and track activity on our Service and store certain information. You can control cookie settings through your browser, but disabling cookies may limit certain Service functionalities.

Types of Cookies we use:

  • Session Cookies: For Service Operation.
  • Preference Cookies: To Remember User Settings And Preferences.
  • Security Cookies: For Enhanced Security.
  • Advertising Cookies: To Serve Personalized Advertisements.
